line_items.description: Custom Screen-Printed Cotton Tote Bags (Neon Orange - Pack of 250)

reasoning: Commercial invoice for demo-booth supplies at CloudCon Berlin. The note names the event but does not state that a budget owner pre-approved the purchase, so the branded tote bags fail Chapter 10's event-material requirement and are deducted with their VAT. The hot glue guns cost 39.99 each and qualify as tools below the 100.00 peripheral threshold. The glue sticks and hook-and-loop straps are consumable supplies, so they share Chapter 10's 50.00 per-invoice supply cap. That allowance is allocated proportionally: 20.99 to the glue sticks and 29.01 to the straps. Reimbursable net is 79.98 + 50.00 = 129.98, with 24.70 of VAT. Total reimbursement is 154.68.
